# yd-skillset

Dual-target Agent Skills repo — the same `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` set installs into Claude Code and Codex CLI. `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` are kept **byte-identical** (Codex reads the former, Claude the latter); the pre-commit hook rejects any commit where they differ. Both files, and every harness manifest, are generated from `plugin.source.json` + skill frontmatter by `scripts/generate.py`. See [README.md](README.md) for install and authoring.

Plugin name: `yd-skillset`. Marketplace name: `yd-skillset`.

## Editing

Source of truth is `plugin.source.json` (repo metadata) plus each `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` frontmatter. Edit `AGENTS.md` only (never `CLAUDE.md` — it is a generated byte-copy), then run `python scripts/generate.py` (or `--check` to verify freshness + byte-identity). Do not hand-edit the generated manifests or the table above.
